- **sources/hillary-clinton-research-file.md**: ### 6a. The leaked DNC staff emails (WikiLeaks, July 2016 — from a DNC server hack) - Emails from ~7 DNC staffers (2015–16) showed derogatory internal commentary about Sanders (DNC Chair Debbie Wasserman Schultz calling his campaign manager "a damn liar," an aide suggesting raising Sanders' religious beliefs as a wedge issue in West Virginia, a communications aide floating using a voter-data dispute to paint the Sanders campaign as disorganized). **DOCUMENTED — these are the actual leaked emails**, published and widely authenticated; DNC Chair Wasserman Schultz resigned days later, right before the convention.
- **sources/hillary-clinton-research-file.md**: … The Joint Fundraising Agreement (revealed by Donna Brazile, Nov. 2017, in *Politico*/her book *Hacks*) - **DOCUMENTED, from a real signed document Brazile says she found:** In August 2015 — four months after Clinton entered the race and a full year before she clinched the nomination — the DNC (then run by Wasserman Schultz, CEO Amy Dacey), the **Hillary Victory Fund**, and **Hillary for America** signed a Joint Fundraising Agreement. Per Brazile's account (which is what's publicly available; I have not independently reviewed the primary document myself in this pass — **REPORTED, sourced to Brazile's direct account of a document she says she saw**): in exchange for the Clinton campaign raising money for and effectively bailing out a debt-ridden DNC (roughly $10M, ~80% of its remaining debt, per Brazile), the agreement gave Hillary for America **advance consultation/right-of-refusal over DNC communications-director hiring, and final say on DNC staffing, budgeting, data, analytics, and mailings** — while Sanders was still actively competing for the nomination.
